system.description:
You radiate a powerful aura of lightning energy in an aura with a radius centered on you, enhancing the combat potential in yourself and friendly creatures.

The aura moves with you. While in the aura, whenever a creature of your choice would deal their [Weapons damage], they add +1d6 Lightning damage to the result.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the radius by 10 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, their [Weapon damage], Penetrates 4 DR. Additionally, if you score a critical hit with a weapon enhanced by this jutsu, the target creature gains +1 rank of Shocked.
